'''Sa'har Kateen's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|purple]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Disorder" />

==History==
[[File:MalgusVsKateen-Disorder.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sa'har duels Darth Malgus in the Temple of Nul on Elom.]]
Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> Sa'har [[Mission to Elom|dueled]] the rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] for [[Darth Nul's holocron]] in the [[Temple of Nul]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], but she was unfortunately [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] and was later buried under the rubble of the collapsing temple by Malgus, who took the opportunity to take the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from her.<ref name="Disorder" />

[[File:Sahar_Kateen_fights_Tyrus_Brokenblade.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Sa'har fights Tyrus Brokenblade.]]
During the [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|raid]] on [[Kessan's Landing]], Sa'har secretly traveled to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where the [[Hidden Chain]] were abducting civilians and stealing cooling rods. As the situation intensified, [[Petra Nihrum]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] found themselves in a fierce fight with [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], the leader of the raid. While Tyrus was able to injure Petra, Sa'har intervened before Tyrus could execute Petra. Although the angry leader of [[Clan Varad]] warned Sa'har that [[Heta Kol]] would kill her for her betrayal, she ignored the threat. However, she became quickly provoked as he suggested that her brother [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]] would execute her himself.<ref name="Storming the Castle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sa'har Kateen's lightsaber first appeared in ''[[Disorder]]'', the sixth cinematic trailer for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Disorder" /> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> Sa'har Kateen's lightsaber is available for purchase in the game's [[Cartel Market]] following Game Update 7.1.1 released on [[October]] [[2022]].<ref name="Cartel">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221018-1|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 7.1.1}}</ref>
